question: Can neutral synaptic exploration cross WSP15's structural credit barrier after an actual contradictory witness, while preserving previously valid observations?
hypothesis: From each frozen WSP15 acquired circuit, neutral non-worsening numeric updates recover the new witness in at least122/128 tasks, fit at least730/768 total observations after adaptation, and retain every previously correct original prediction. A missed condition is SCIENTIFIC_NEGATIVE; no post-result budget or policy tuning.

frozen_design.initial_tasks: 32 original signatures at [0,1,2,4,7] x seeds [17,29,43,71]. Initial state is exactly WSP15 strict update with1024 trials, independently reproduced. No cherry-picked successful circuits.
frozen_design.contradiction: One new observed context3 with label opposite the initial circuit prediction. This is a deliberately adversarial witnessed relationship, not unexplained environment drift. All methods get identical actual five+one observations per paired task. The witness is not an input to noise proposal generation.
frozen_design.hidden: contexts5,6; exhaustively score all4 compatible assignments per task. Each deterministic evidence-only arm must be exactly512/1024. No unseen-family generalization claim.
frozen_design.budget: 1024 further single-row rewire proposals per arm/task, noise seed unchanged and restarted. No early exit or extra attempts. Same six NAND sites /75 binary synaptic scalars as WSP15.
frozen_design.plasticity: Numeric mismatch/reward threshold commits trial weights when total six-observation mismatch does not increase. This permits neutral intermediate wiring. Same generic simulator, independent noise, masked updates; no symbolic graph selection. Original five observations are replayed and counted as external evidence storage (not synaptic memory).

controls.strict: Same initial circuit, six observations and noise; strict reward threshold as WSP15
controls.symbolic: Exact frozen WSP14 NAND catalog, select lowest(cost,mask) compatible with SIX observed labels. Full setup measured; no hidden labels. Independent symbolic expression output.
controls.precompiled: Numerical WSP14 circuit from symbolic selection; external compiled control only
controls.trained: Eight independent logits, genuine Adam LR.1,BCE<=.02 within2048 steps, SIX observations; all128 tasks convergence mandatory. Equal information, not capacity/FLOP-matched strongest structural neural baseline
controls.negative: No witness arm must keep the initial graph unchanged; ambiguity of two unobserved labels remains50%; corrupted checkpoints rejected

classification_rules.dev_supported: witness correct>=122/128 AND total observed>=730/768 AND zero loss of previously correct original predictions AND reproducible128/128 cold restores
classification_rules.negative: any frozen recovery/retention threshold missed with valid controls
classification_rules.invalid: hidden leakage, changed seeds/budget/threshold, invalid source/custody or comparator, task-specific external selection
classification_rules.scientific_pass: Unavailable: authored public DEV and strongest exact symbolic reference. No superiority without independent matched whole-process comparison

qualification: Final exact SHA/tree, all original+WSP01-16 tests, WSP16 frozen evaluator, source integrity/permanent atlas on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu and Windows2022. Predecessor evaluator outcomes reused only at exact unchanged predecessor blobs; previous full suite is not a substitute for final unit regression.
preregistration_note: Committed locally AND published remotely before implementation and all primary WSP16 execution; WSP15 negative remains frozen and unchanged.
